purpose: A reviewed reference set for testing taxonomy and annotation contracts; it is not a redistributable question bank.

rules: one record may reference multiple topics
do not put a CASE.* ID in topics
case records require at least one capability
comprehensive records use an empty capability array in v0.1
one case may reference multiple capabilities
do not put a knowledge topic ID in capabilities

fields.id: Stable local golden-set record ID; it is not a source question ID.

source.rule: Use non-empty repository-relative source_path and source_question_id with an immutable source_commit. Do not include a local absolute path.

identification.rule: Only the shortest non-substitutive recognition summary is allowed; do not copy the stem, options, answer, analysis, OCR or full case body.

fields.capabilities: Array of capability_reference objects; comprehensive records use an empty array in v0.1.

annotation.rule: AI suggestions may be candidate only; confirmed means a human reviewed the references and mapping.

validation_invariants: Every record has at least one topic reference.
Every case record has at least one capability reference; comprehensive records have none.
Canonical IDs must not introduce OTHER, UNKNOWN, MISC, or UNCLASSIFIED segments.
Duplicate record IDs are invalid across both sample files.
